- Sandbox-to-prod is generally free to stage; cost changes only once traffic moves to prod endpoints. We can set up a short trial prod cap to manage spend.
- Term amendment: if total committed capacity increases >25% we usually do a brief SOW addendum (billing cadence unchanged). If they want price protections or new SLAs we document that in the amendment.
